ycy config fork
Manage git fork provider instances
Usage:
  ycy config fork [flags]
Commands:
  add	Add a provider instance
  list	List configured provider instances
  remove	Remove a provider instance
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for fork
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
